title: JCT vs NEC: Which Construction Contract Is Right?
description: JCT and NEC4 compared: language, project management, risk, payment, change and disputes, with guidance on which suits your UK construction project.
h1: JCT vs NEC: which construction contract is right for you?
intro: JCT and NEC are the UK’s two leading families of construction contract. Both comply with the Construction Act and both work well, but they ask very different things of the people running them.

image.alt: Two people shaking hands over a paper agreement

cardText: Language, project management, risk, payment and change compared across JCT and NEC4.

sections.html:
JCTNEC4
StyleTraditional legal draftingPlain, present-tense language
ManagementContract administrator certifies; fewer process stepsActive management: early warnings, accepted programme, strict response times
ChangeVariations valued under valuation rules; time and money assessed separatelyCompensation events assessed for time and money together, using quotations
Time barsNotice “forthwith” for delay; fewer strict time bars8-week time bar for notifying compensation events
Pricing optionsDifferent forms for different routesMain Options A–F within one contract
Typical usersPrivate-sector buildingPublic sector and infrastructure, increasingly building

• Choose NEC if both sides have the people and systems to run its processes, you want collaborative risk management and you value a live programme.
  • Choose JCT for many traditional building projects, where the team and supply chain know it well and you prefer a lighter administrative load.

Read our guides to JCT and NEC4, and procurement routes.

General information, not legal advice. What applies to you depends on your contract, the facts and where the work is, and the law changes. Check the sources below and take advice from a qualified professional before acting on anything that matters.

faqs.q: Is NEC more collaborative than JCT?
faqs.a: NEC builds collaboration into its processes, with a duty to act in a spirit of mutual trust and co-operation. JCT has collaborative provisions too, and a Collaborative Contract form. How collaborative a project is depends mostly on the people.
